steps.en: The EHT system sends each notice live and OCMS takes it in immediately
steps.id: Sistem EHT mengirim tiap notice secara langsung dan OCMS langsung menerimanya
steps.why_en: Only a Certis path exists; nothing in the repo proves the EHT system sends through it.
steps.why_id: Hanya jalur Certis yang ada; tidak ada bukti di repo bahwa sistem EHT mengirim lewat jalur itu.

steps.en: Incoming notice data is checked before it is accepted
steps.id: Data notice yang masuk diperiksa dulu sebelum diterima

steps.en: A Notice of Parking Offence is saved as a new notice
steps.id: Notice of Parking Offence disimpan sebagai notice baru

steps.en: An Advisory Notice is recognised and kept as an advisory
steps.id: Advisory Notice dikenali dan disimpan sebagai advisory

steps.en: A notice for unauthorised parking lot use, without a vehicle number, is saved
steps.id: Notice penggunaan parking lot tanpa izin, tanpa nomor kendaraan, disimpan

steps.en: A saved notice gets its first processing step so work can start
steps.id: Notice yang tersimpan diberi langkah proses pertama supaya kerja bisa mulai

steps.en: Every receipt is recorded and the sender is told the result at once
steps.id: Setiap penerimaan dicatat dan pengirim langsung diberi tahu hasilnya
